messages:
maria: PR up — https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra-configs/pull/2147
maria: fixes cert thumbprint mismatch for NovumCare private deploy. rolling to staging in ~2h. need infra/security approvals. @ben @samir @nina PTAL
ben: on it, running configcheck locally
config-bot: terraform plan for branch novumcare/cert-fix:
```
+ resource "aws_acm_certificate" "novumcare" {
  domain_name = "novumcare.corp.example"
  validation = "DNS"
}
```
samir: small naming nit — KMS alias should be `alias/redwood/novumcare` not `alias/novumcare`. otherwise LGTM
nina: security: quick q — can we extend cert rotation window to 7 days before cutover? also file a JIRA for audit trail (AUTH-1294)
maria: updated PR with KMS alias change and added rotation note + test steps. linked AUTH-1294. I'll hold merge until security ACK and one more infra approval
ben: running smoke deploy to staging now, will post logs shortly
ben: smoke looks clean, no cert errors in access logs; approved :thumbsup:
nina: reviewed, ok with 7-day rotation as long as audit ticket exists. security approves :white_check_mark:
maria: thanks — merging in ~30m unless anyone objects. will notify #incidents if rollout sees any 5xx
samir: ack
maria: merge done. deploy triggered. monitoring watching :eyes:
config-bot: deploy status: succeeded (staging) — no errors
maria: closing the loop — will schedule production rollout tomorrow 10:00 UTC, will post runbook in thread.
